description: This file defines a keyboard interaction handler for a map, enabling navigation via keyboard keys such as arrows and zoom keys. It extends a Handler class and integrates with the map to provide focus, zoom, and pan functionalities.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: A handler class extending Handler to manage keyboard interactions for map navigation, including panning and zooming.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Keyboard handler with the map instance and sets pan and zoom deltas.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Adds event listeners to enable keyboard interaction and focus management.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes event listeners to disable keyboard interaction.

methods.name: _onMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down event to focus the map container.

methods.name: _onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, setting internal state and firing a focus event.

methods.name: _onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, updating internal state and firing a blur event.

methods.name: _setPanDelta
methods.description: Configures pan offsets for arrow keys based on the pan delta.

methods.name: _setZoomDelta
methods.description: Configures zoom step sizes for zoom in/out keys.

methods.name: _addHooks
methods.description: Attaches keydown event listener for handling key presses.

methods.name: _onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events to perform map panning and zooming based on pressed keys.
